summary: sysvinit options: arguments, daemonize for badly behaved init scripts, enabled, name, pattern for ps-based status, runlevels, sleep between stop/start, and state.
questions: Why does my init script hang the Ansible task?
How do I enable a SysV service on specific runlevels?
How do I check a service without a status command?

answer_card.title: sysvinit parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `name` (required)
- `state`: started/stopped/restarted/reloaded (restart/reload may do stop+start)
- `enabled`, `runlevels`: override default runlevels
- `daemonize` (false): fixes hanging tasks or services dying when session closes
- `pattern`: ps substring for status
- `sleep` (1s), `arguments`
